current_point.claim: 提出了GSAERU模型中的时序学习模块，该模块在获得单时间步图表征后，采用循环神经网络学习原图在时间维度上的特征信息与依赖关系，从而得到大规模时序图的高质量表征。
current_point.claim_en: Proposed the time sequence learning module in the GSAERU model, which, after obtaining graph representation at a single time step, uses a recurrent neural network to learn the feature information and dependencies of the original graph along the time dimension, thereby obtaining high-quality representations for large-scale sequential graphs.
technical_features: 将单时间步上获得的图表征输入时序学习模块
通过循环神经网络学习时间维度上的特征信息与依赖关系
输出大规模时序图的高质量表征
technical_features_en: Feed the graph representation obtained at a single time step into the time sequence learning module
Learn feature information and dependencies along the time dimension through a recurrent neural network
Produce high-quality representations for large-scale sequential graphs
